question_text: What year was IKEA founded?
source_note: Founded by Ingvar Kamprad in Älmhult, Sweden.

question_text: What year did the Berlin Wall fall?
source_note: The wall came down on November 9, 1989.

question_text: In what year was the Eiffel Tower completed?
source_note: Built for the 1889 World's Fair.

question_text: What year did the Titanic sink?
source_note: Sank on its maiden voyage, April 15, 1912.

question_text: What year was the first iPhone released?
source_note: Announced by Steve Jobs in January, released in June 2007.

question_text: In what year did World War II end?
source_note: Ended with Japan's surrender in September 1945.

question_text: What year was the United Nations founded?
source_note: Founded after WWII to promote international cooperation.

question_text: What year did Christopher Columbus first reach the Americas?
source_note: He landed in the Bahamas in October 1492.

question_text: How many bones are in the adult human body?
source_note: Babies are born with about 300, many fuse together with age.

question_text: What is the average gestation period of an African elephant, in days?
source_note: Roughly 22 months — the longest of any land mammal.

question_text: How many hearts does an octopus have?
source_note: Two pump blood to the gills, one to the rest of the body.

question_text: What is the top speed of a peregrine falcon during a hunting dive, in km/h?
source_note: The fastest animal on Earth in a diving stoop.

question_text: How many species of shark are there, roughly?
source_note: Marine biologists estimate over 500 known species.

question_text: How many years can a giant tortoise live, roughly, at maximum recorded age?
source_note: Jonathan the tortoise is verified at over 190 years old.

question_text: What percentage of Earth's water is fresh water, roughly?
source_note: About 2.5–3% of all water on Earth is fresh water.

question_text: How many teeth does an adult human typically have?
source_note: Including all four wisdom teeth.

question_text: How many players are on a soccer team on the field at once?
source_note: Eleven players per side, including the goalkeeper.

question_text: In what year did the first modern Olympic Games take place?
source_note: Held in Athens, Greece.

question_text: How many Grand Slam singles titles did Roger Federer win in his career?
source_note: Across the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open.

question_text: What is the length of a marathon, in kilometers (rounded)?
source_note: The official distance is 42.195 km.

question_text: How many players are on a basketball team on the court at once, per side?
source_note: Five players per team on the court.

question_text: How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
source_note: Representing five inhabited continents.

question_text: How many minutes are in a standard FIFA soccer match, excluding stoppage time?
source_note: Two 45-minute halves.

question_text: What year did the first Harry Potter book get published?
source_note: "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone" published in the UK.

question_text: How many Oscars did "Titanic" (1997) win in total?
source_note: Tied the record for most Oscars won by a single film.

question_text: What year was the first "Star Wars" film released?
source_note: Later retitled "Episode IV – A New Hope."

question_text: How many seasons did "Friends" run for?
source_note: The show aired from 1994 to 2004.

question_text: What year did Nintendo release the original Game Boy?
source_note: Released in Japan in April 1989.

question_text: How many Grammy Awards has Beyoncé won, as of 2024?
source_note: The most Grammy wins of any artist in history.

question_text: What year did the first "Toy Story" film release?
source_note: The first fully computer-animated feature film.
